==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommonerFemale.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Maikeen Storn]]
Maikeen Storn was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Maikeen Storn spawned under the generic "farmer_female" template, her appearance was randomized under one of fifty possible depictions. [[Species/Legends|Species]] Storn could appear as included [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], and [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] of the female [[Gender/Legends|gender]]. The [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Storn as female, and she would never spawn as a male, however the [[canon]]ical species cannot be definitively determined in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="AED" />
